metadata.description: Act 2 weak-tier representative: TUNNELER_WEAK encounter, single Tunneler enemy with no slot args. Setup-only fixture (no actions) — pins the post-setup pre-first-action bridge-state shape for an act2 monster_id ('Tunneler'). Tunneler's BURROW ↔ BITE AI is intentionally NOT rolled here; intent stays None so the test does not depend on the intent-roll determinism path. Tier coverage: weak; the other tiers (normal/elite/boss) for Act 2 + Act 3 remain open under sts2-rs-rggx and are gated on sts2-rs-69u4 for the multi-creature / start-of-combat-power harness extensions per the YellowKnoll stash notes (Queen → RoyalGuard minion spawns, ThievingHopper THIEVERY application).
metadata.limits: Single-creature, no slot args, no start-of-combat power. Multi-creature minion-spawn encounters (Bowlbugs, Exoskeletons, Queen, TheInsatiable) and start-of-combat-power encounters (ThievingHopper) are deferred to sts2-rs-69u4.
